description: 1 << a not folded to a + 1 when a is known to be 0 or 1
notes: C taken from the issue's src reproducer; clang produces the issue's IR. The IR instruction count does not change (shl to add): godbolt llc trunk (-mcpu=skylake) emits mov + shlx for the source and a single lea for the target. Open fix: llvm/llvm-project PR #207108, which also covers llvm-issue-207089. expected.ll from the issue's tgt function (add nuw nsw a, 1), with the assume kept. expected.ll proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 alive-tv, 2026-10-28: src = clang trunk -O3 IR of src.c (godbolt cclang_trunk, -O3 --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -march=skylake -emit-llvm -S -g0) renamed @src, tgt = expected.ll renamed @tgt, identical signature; output 'Transformation seems to be correct!' with no warning. Run on Alive2's own Compiler Explorer instance (alive2.llvm.org/ce, compiler id 'alive'), since godbolt.org does not host alive-tv.
